result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: one audit per twelve months, 30 days' written notice, business-hours timing, an independent auditor under written confidentiality obligations, Vendor-paid costs unless underpayment exceeds 5%, and no direct or remote systems access. It preserves the audit right and existing cost allocation. However, the added off-site-wherever-practicable requirement and express limitation to usage records go somewhat beyond the stated playbook requirements, so the revision is not strictly minimal. Drafting is otherwise professional, though the systems-access prohibition is redundant across Sections 22.1 and 22.2.
